title: Update header brand label to ClashRoyalHub

requirements.summary: Change the global header brand link/label text to exactly "ClashRoyalHub" while keeping Home navigation behavior unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In the global header, the brand label text renders as exactly "ClashRoyalHub" (matching capitalization and spelling).
Clicking the brand label still navigates to the Home page.
No other navigation labels (Home, Beginner Guide, Deck Tips, Discussions, Ask Fred, About, Admin) are changed.

file_operations.description: Update the header brand button label text from "ClashRoyaleHub" to exactly "ClashRoyalHub" without altering the onClick handler that navigates to the Home page, and without changing any other nav item labels.
